name: my-issues
description: A /issues pane of the open issues assigned to you across GitHub, Linear, Jira and monday.com; press an issue to put its key, title and link in your prompt

github.title: GitHub
github.description: List GitHub issues assigned to you, through the gh CLI.

github_scope.title: GitHub scope
github_scope.description: Empty: every repo you can see. "repo": only the repo Claude Code runs in. Otherwise owners and/or owner/repo entries, comma-separated (e.g. my-org, octo/app).

linear.title: Linear
linear.description: List Linear issues assigned to you that are not completed or canceled. Needs LINEAR_API_KEY or the Linear API key setting.

linear_api_key.title: Linear API key
linear_api_key.description: A Linear personal API key. Empty uses the LINEAR_API_KEY environment variable.

jira.title: Jira
jira.description: List Jira Cloud issues matching the JQL below. Needs a site URL, email and API token.

jira_email.title: Jira email
jira_email.description: The Atlassian account email the API token belongs to. Empty uses JIRA_EMAIL.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: An Atlassian API token. Empty uses JIRA_API_TOKEN.

jira_jql.title: Jira JQL
jira_jql.description: The search to list. Empty uses: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

monday.title: monday.com
monday.description: List monday.com items assigned to you in a People column and not marked done. Needs MONDAY_API_TOKEN or the monday.com token setting.

monday_api_token.title: monday.com API token
monday_api_token.description: A monday.com personal API token. Empty uses MONDAY_API_TOKEN.

monday_boards.title: monday.com boards
monday_boards.description: Board ids to scan, comma-separated. Empty scans your 10 most recently used boards.

limit.title: Issues per provider
limit.description: The most issues to list from each provider.

refresh_minutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the pane refreshes while it is open.
